$comment: Schema hashes from upstream src/rx-schema.ts for every upstream fixture schema and a set of synthetic schemas that isolate one defaulting step each (PLAN.md 7.2, GATES tier 2). `hash` is the value of `RxSchema.hash`; `defaultedSchema` is the exact object that was JSON.stringify-ed and hashed, so a mismatch can be attributed to schema defaulting or to hashing instead of just "hash differs".

determinism.mathRandom: xorshift128 seeded with 0x5eed1e55, 1 draw per call
determinism.dateNow: frozen monotonic clock starting at 1700000000000, +1 ms per call
